this paper presents a control and performance analysis of single stage PV system with the following features:     - a) a control strategy for maximum power point tracking (MPPT), voltage control, reactive power control, and grid synchronization is presented;     - b) small signal stability/eignvalue analysis of the complete linearized system model is performed to evaluate the robustness of controller;     - c) the dynamic performance is evaluated in real time digital simulator (RTDS) environment.
